jobs.description:
Our Global SAP team is a truly global team with over 100 employees and is known for its focus on sustainable value creation by translating the latest IT innovations into solutions and services. We use the newest state-of-the-art S/4HANA features as our strategic platform to permanently optimize and enhance our global template. The world-wide SAP roll-out journey continues. The organization is currently undergoing a transformation towards digitalization, advancing fundamental elements to meet future needs, such as using new technologies. YOU can be part of this highly motivated team to ensure Sika’s continuing success on the digital journey. For our growing SAP Team in Zurich , we are looking for a passionate and experienced Senior Solution Architect/Project Manager SAP FIN In this challenging role, you will have the opportunity to work in a highly innovative environment that will together with external partners to perform rollouts in record time. 
• What we offer you: You will take responsibility for the realization of challenging SAP projects and international rollouts within our Global SAP Team. You will play a key role in the configuration and implementation of SAP FIN solutions on S/4 HANA, including finance core processes, overhead controlling, product costing, profitability analysis and related integration scenarios. In our global SAP FI/CO rollouts, you will support all phases of the project life cycle which includes analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and end user training. You will customize and configure SAP FIN applications in close collaboration with business process experts and implement these solutions using well defined methodologies such as data migration, key user enablement, testing activities, and go live support. You will analyse and challenge existing business processes, identify gaps, and translate requirements into our global SAP template using best practices to improve process quality, performance, and overall acceptance. You will also support our SAP FI/CO environment through second and third level activities, including change requests, incident management, and guidance for key users.

Il viaggio di roll-out di SAP a livello mondiale continua. L’organizzazione sta attualmente attraversando una trasformazione verso la digitalizzazione, apportando elementi fondamentali per soddisfare le esigenze future, come l’utilizzo delle nuove tecnologie. TU puoi far parte di questo team altamente motivato per garantire il continuo successo di Sika nel viaggio digitale. Per il nostro team SAP in crescita a Zurigo, stiamo cercando un Senior Solution Architect/Project Manager SAP FIN appassionato ed esperto. In questo ruolo impegnativo, avrai l'opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente altamente innovativo che, insieme a partner esterni, eseguirà implementazioni in tempi record.
• Cosa ti offriamo: ti assumerai la responsabilità della realizzazione di progetti SAP impegnativi e implementazioni internazionali all'interno del nostro team SAP globale. Avrai un ruolo chiave nella configurazione e implementazione delle soluzioni SAP FIN su S/4 HANA, inclusi i processi finanziari principali, il controllo delle spese generali, la determinazione dei costi dei prodotti, l'analisi della redditività e i relativi scenari di integrazione. Nelle nostre implementazioni globali di SAP FI/CO, supporterai tutte le fasi del ciclo di vita del progetto che includono analisi, progettazione, sviluppo, test, distribuzione, documentazione e formazione degli utenti finali. Personalizzerai e configurerai le applicazioni SAP FIN in stretta collaborazione con esperti di processi aziendali e implementerai queste soluzioni utilizzando metodologie ben definite come migrazione dei dati, abilitazione degli utenti chiave, attività di test e supporto operativo. Analizzerai e sfiderai i processi aziendali esistenti, identificherai le lacune e tradurrai i requisiti nel nostro modello SAP globale utilizzando le migliori pratiche per migliorare la qualità dei processi, le prestazioni e l'accettazione generale. Supporterai inoltre il nostro ambiente SAP FI/CO attraverso attività di secondo e terzo livello, tra cui richieste di modifica, gestione degli incidenti e indicazioni per gli utenti chiave.

jobs.description: We are seeking for a very knowledgeable and experienced SAP developer with expertise on Transportation Management, who can assist on digital transformation and strategic TM programs, enhancing and safeguarding SIKA global template solutions. Strong communication skills and bold personality are required to discuss with various stakeholders about technical solutions in different levels (functional, business, management as well as with other technical teams). The Senior Technical Consultant will be responsible for custom development in SAP Transportation Management using ABAP OO, BOPF, FPM, PPF, BRF+, CDS views, and OData services. He or she must have expertise in TM Freight Units, Freight Orders, Charge Management, planning logic, and carrier integration at technical level. Must be able to design, build, and optimize TM processes, ensuring high-quality, scalable solutions aligned with SAP Clean Core practices as well as BTP extensions, event-driven architecture, AI/ML, and SAP Joule to modernize TM processes and deliver next-generation digital logistics capabilities. Main activities include: Design, implement, and maintain custom developments related to Freight Units, Freight Order and other business objects belonging to transportation management scope Enhance planning and execution screens as well as other FPM applications (UI enhancements, BADIs, enhancements points) Implement charge calculation automation using BRF+ Implement and modify PPF actions (printing, output, event-driven actions) Design and apply custom logic for transportation network modeling (means of transport, locations, routes) General TM enhancements using BOPF, FPM, FBI and other related frameworks Enhancement of TM master data models and interfaces, using BOs and CDS views Fiori and UI5 development and enhancements related to latest TM custom/standard applications Set up and activation of Fiori applications and technical catalogs, as well as oData services (standard and custom) Design and implementation of side-by-side extensions using BTP services Review and approval of functional design documents before releasing to development Design of technical documentation Technical coaching of other team members and handover of project deliverables to support organization

jobs.description:
The Data Management Trainings Specialist designs and establishes a structured communication and training concept that ensures consistent understanding, correct usage, and sustainable adoption of the Product Information Management (PIM) and PIM system across the organization. That enables corporate and business users, data roles, and stakeholders to know what PIM is and work effectively and compliantly with the PIM system by providing clear communication, role‑specific training, and ongoing guidance aligned with PIM governance, data quality standards, and organizational change requirements. Main tasks: - Design and maintain a structured training concept for PIM, Data Management and PIM system, aligned with governance rules, data quality standards, and corporate/business processes. - Develop role‑based training materials (e.g. onboarding, refresher, advanced training) for different data roles such as data creators, data stewards, approvers, etc. - Deliver training sessions in various formats (live, virtual, self‑learning materials, etc.) to ensure effective knowledge transfer and adoption. - Coordinate training content with PIM Project Coordination, Product Data Management, PIM Governance, IT, and corporate/business stakeholders to ensure consistency and accuracy. - Continuously review and update training materials based on system changes, process updates, and user feedback. 
• Responsibilities : - Responsibility for designing, maintaining, and delivering the PIM, Data Management and PIM system training concept, ensuring alignment with approved PIM governance rules, data standards, and processes. - Responsibility for defining role‑based training curricula and learning paths for different PIM user groups (e.g. data creators, data managers, approvers, etc.), based on governance requirements. - Responsibility for planning and conducting training sessions (onboarding, refresher, and update trainings) to enable efficient and compliant use of the PIM system. - Responsible for ensuring that training materials remain up to date and reflect current system functionality, processes, and compliance requirements.

The organization is currently undergoing a transformation towards digitalization, advancing fundamental elements to meet future needs, such as using new technologies. YOU can be part of this highly motivated team to ensure Sika’s continuing success on the digital journey. For our growing SAP Team in Zurich , we are looking for a passionate and experienced Senior Solution Architect/Project Manager SAP EWM In this challenging role, you will have the opportunity to work in a highly innovative environment that will together with external partners to perform rollouts in record time.

jobs.description: Für den Lehrbeginn im August 2027 suchen wir interessierte, junge Menschen für die Lehrstelle als Polymechaniker/in EFZ. Du lernst, wie mechanische, pneumatische und hydraulische Systeme funktionieren und wie man Störungen effizient behebt. Das präzise Arbeiten mit Werkzeugmaschinen sowie das Warten und Reparieren von Bauteilen aus Metall und Kunststoffen gehören zu wichtigen Kenntnissen, welche du während deiner Ausbildung erlangen wirst. La nostra formazione di base versatile ed emozionante ti permette un inizio ottimale nel mondo del lavoro.

jobs.description:
Für den Lehrbeginn im August 2027 suchen wir interessierte, junge Menschen für die Lehrstelle als Logistiker/in EFZ. Täglich werden verschiedenste Materialien angeliefert, verarbeitet, und Halb- und Fertigprodukte müssen gelagert und versandt werden. Zu den 
• Aufgaben des Logistikers gehört die Warenannahme, Eingangskontrolle, Ein- und Umlagerungen, Bestandsaufnahme, die Lagerbetreuung und das Verpacken und Sichern der Transportgüter, mit dem Ziel, die richtige Menge der richtigen Ware rechtzeitig und kostengünstig am richtigen Ort bereitzustellen. Stapler, Elektrofahrzeuge und andere technische Hilfsmittel erleichtern die körperliche Arbeit. Der Computer hat auch vor dem Lager keinen Halt gemacht, sämtliche Warenein- und -ausgänge müssen erfasst werden. Unsere vielseitige und spannende Grundbildung ermöglicht dir einen optimalen Start in die Arbeitswelt.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Per l'inizio dell'apprendistato nell'agosto 2027, cerchiamo giovani interessati all'apprendistato come specialista in logistica EFZ. Ogni giorno viene consegnata e lavorata una grande varietà di materiali, e i prodotti semifiniti e finiti devono essere conservati e spediti.
• I compiti dello specialista logistico includono la ricezione delle merci, l'ispezione in entrata, lo stoccaggio e il trasferimento, l'inventario, la gestione del magazzino e l'imballaggio e la sicurezza delle merci trasportate, con l'obiettivo di fornire la giusta quantità delle merci giuste nel luogo giusto, nei tempi e in termini di costi efficaci. Carrelli elevatori, veicoli elettrici e altri ausili tecnici rendono il lavoro fisico più semplice. Il computer non si è fermato nemmeno al magazzino, tutte le merci in entrata e in uscita devono essere registrate. La nostra formazione di base versatile ed entusiasmante ti offre il miglior inizio possibile nel mondo del lavoro.
descriptionByLocale.en:
For the start of the apprenticeship in August 2027, we are looking for interested young people for the apprenticeship as a logistics specialist EFZ. Every day, a wide variety of materials are delivered and processed, and semi-finished and finished products have to be stored and shipped.
• The tasks of the logistics specialist include the receipt of goods, incoming inspection, storage and transfer, inventory, warehouse management and the packing and securing of the transported goods, with the aim of providing the right quantity of the right goods in the right place on time and cost-effectively. Forklifts, electric vehicles and other technical aids make physical work easier. The computer has not stopped at the warehouse either, all incoming and outgoing goods have to be recorded. Our versatile and exciting basic education gives you the best possible start in the world of work.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Consultant SAP Integration
jobs.description: We’re looking for a Senior Technical Consultant SAP Integration to join our SAP Technology team in Zurich. In this strategic assignment, you'll play a critical role of developing and managing complex integration projects, while ensuring the performance, stability, and security of SAP integrations. The Senior Technical Consultant SAP Integration shall report to the SAP Integration lead and work in synergy with SAP Development and SAP Basis workstreams, as well as other SAP functional teams. As a Senior Technical Consultant SAP Integration, you will: Design, develop, and manage integration architectures using SAP Integration Suite, SAP PO/PI, API Management, and other relevant tools. Collaborate with functional and technical teams to define integration requirements and ensure end-to-end solution consistency. Ensure smooth operations of all integration interfaces and resolve complex issues in a timely manner. Drive the adoption of integration best practices, security standards, and performance optimization techniques. Support and mentor a other team members, providing technical guidance and reviewing deliverables. Support project delivery teams in integration-related tasks throughout the system development lifecycle. Heavily contribute to the cloud adoption journey of SIKA in the integration space. Stay current with SAP’s latest integration technologies and trends (e.g., Event Mesh, BTP, APIs, CDS Views).

Il Senior Technical Consultant SAP Integration riferisce al lead e al lavoro SAP Integration in sinergia con i flussi di lavoro SAP Development e SAP Basis, nonché altri team funzionali SAP. Come Senior Technical Consultant SAP Integration, potrai: Progettazione, sviluppo e gestione di architetture di integrazione utilizzando SAP Integration Suite, SAP PO/PI, API Management e altri strumenti rilevanti. Collabora con team funzionali e tecnici per definire i requisiti di integrazione e garantire la coerenza delle soluzioni end-to-end.
